<!-- pr-reviewer: a10081ac8f098d5c16387f6077cee342d83e96af -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Thanks for the fix, @mkinney.

**What looks good**
- Minimal change: one manifest line in `assets/posts/heidenhain.cps` plus a source citation comment; no build.rs, `.github/`, scripts or dependency changes.
- The new test `every_builtin_declares_its_controls_file_extension` (`crates/app/tests/conformance.rs`) pins every shipped post's extension and fails if a post is added without being listed, so the fix cannot silently regress.
- No unwrap/expect/panic outside tests; posted text and goldens are unchanged (the byte-exact golden test still passes).
- Clean-room: cites the public Heidenhain user manual; PR body has `Changelog:` and ends `Fixes #52`; conventional commit subject; no CHANGELOG.md edit.

**Local results (merged with current main, trial merge was clean)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test conformance` | 6 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --tests -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Only the conformance suite was run, since the diff touches nothing else.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
